text: {"lessons":["I sold several stocks at a gain, but a gain versus my purchase price alone is not a reason to sell; judge each position by its future prospects and role in my portfolio.","I should not let loss aversion or reluctance to admit a mistake keep me holding a losing stock; use the same forward-looking criteria for winners and losers.","Short-term price moves are random, so I should avoid reacting to daily noise or overtrading and instead keep a diversified portfolio aligned with my goals."]}
